class.name: MVBrakeSettings
class.brief_description: Anti-lock braking and brake force share of a wheel.
class.description: Shared brake data referenced by any number of wheels. Every setter clamps the value to its valid range and emits [signal Resource.changed] only when the value actually changed.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], anti-lock braking can release the brake on this wheel. The handbrake always bypasses ABS.
How long the ABS releases the brake, in seconds, when the spin threshold is crossed.
The difference in speed, in m/s, required between the wheel and the driving surface for ABS to engage.

Share of the total brake force of the vehicle this wheel receives. [code]-1[/code] computes it automatically from the static load on the wheel; values of [code]0[/code] or more are relative weights that are normalised over all wheels of the vehicle.
